summary.text: The gluttonous demon frog is a food path legendary immemorial beast whose body holds Reckless Savage Demon Venerable's immortal aperture, Myriad Beast Fusion Color Heaven.

claims.text: In a dream of Myriad Beast Fusion Color Heaven, a flesh tunnel with vibrating walls and flowing gastric acid is the intestine of the gluttonous demon frog. Reckless Savage Demon Venerable left his true inheritance, Myriad Beast Fusion Color Heaven, there.

In Old Eccentric Tian Nan’s true inheritance, Reckless Savage Demon Venerable’s later notes say the lingering beastmen wanted to use food path to claim victory, and that they think he has not discovered that gluttonous demon frog. Historical records say he used those lingering beastmen in his old age to create Reckless Savage grotto-heaven and leave his true inheritance inside it.

Myriad Beast Fusion Color Heaven is Reckless Savage Demon Venerable’s immortal aperture, left within the body of the gluttonous demon frog so the grotto-heaven has a food path environment. The frog is a legendary immemorial beast and holds an unimaginable number of food path dao marks. Under those marks, humans inside the grotto-heaven can eat Gu materials to raise matching dao marks and build totems.

From Tian Nan’s true inheritance, Fang Yuan learns that Reckless Savage used the beastman’s method against them, fusing his own immortal aperture into the gluttonous demon frog’s body. The frog is a food path legendary immemorial beast. With it encompassing the immortal aperture, and with Reckless Savage’s method, Myriad Beast Fusion Color Heaven develops a food path environment. That environment lets cultivators cook with refinement path methods at low food path attainment and make food that supports totem cultivation.
Fang Yuan later judges that Reckless Savage only made use of the gluttonous demon frog for food path understanding, while the totem killer move archetype built from that environment is extraordinary.
